purpose: Teach: 文藝春秋/自営業/発刊/主将/関心事/講堂/ブレーク/学識

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、文藝春秋系の取材にもご対応されますね
lines.en: I see the police also respond to inquiries from Bungei-Shunju magazine.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly deferential. Measured pace. The tone of someone impressed and noting it. Slight upward lift at the end, offering appreciation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、自営業の方々への防犯啓発もされますね
lines.en: And you also conduct crime prevention awareness programs for self-employed business owners.
lines.style: Continuing the same warm, cataloguing tone. Steady, unhurried. Building a picture of all the work being done. Gentle emphasis on the scope of effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯誌の発刊も検討されてますね
lines.en: You're even considering launching a crime prevention magazine.
lines.style: Light surprise beneath the surface warmth. A small breath before the observation. Slightly quickened pace as the enthusiasm shows. Genuine appreciation of the ambition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯協議会の主将的な存在ですね
lines.en: You seem to be a leading presence in the local crime prevention council.
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Deliberate pacing. Not asking—stating what he's observed. Respectful but certain. The voice of someone recognising leadership.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民の関心事に応えてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: You really do respond to what matters to the community.
lines.style: Genuine warmth now. Slower pace, more reflective. The summary statement of someone who's been listening and is moved by what he's heard. Slight emphasis on 'really.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、講堂で市民向け防犯講座を開かれますね
lines.en: And you hold crime prevention lectures for citizens at the community hall.
lines.style: Back to the steady, appreciative cataloguing. Warm but measured. The voice of someone adding to a list of good work. No strain in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のブレークスルーをご報告ありがとうございます
lines.en: Thank you for reporting that breakthrough in the investigation.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude, slightly more formal now. Respectful nod in the voice. Unhurried. Genuine thanks, not performative. A small pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、学識経験者を捜査の助言者に招かれますね
lines.en: I see you've also brought in academic experts to advise on the investigation.
lines.style: Shift to something more intimate. Closer, quieter. Less formalised than the previous lines. The warmth of someone who feels he can speak more directly now. Still respectful, but the distance has narrowed.
